clusters.description: Purified rat neuronal nitric oxide synthase (nNOS) homodimer crosslinked with human calmodulin (CaM) using DSBU.
clusters.biological_condition: purified nNOS incubated with CaM (Ca2+ and tetrahydrobiopterin present) and crosslinked with DSBU
clusters.evidence_quote: MS-cleavable bifunctional crosslinker disuccinimidyl dibutyric urea was used to identify thirteen unique crosslinks between CaM and nNOS as well as 61 crosslinks within the nNOS.
clusters.reasoning: The publication explicitly states DSBU was used for crosslinking CaM with nNOS, and the dataset organism provided is rat (Rattus norvegicus) consistent with purified full-length rat nNOS. The single raw filename does not encode condition or crosslinker, so the DSBU assignment relies on the publication-level methods.
